inputs.text: A jury found Harry Wait guilty after he requested ballots for Robin Vos and Cory Mason without their consent—an irresponsible way to test election security, whatever his stated motive. You don’t protect public confidence by breaking the rules and handing critics an excuse to dismiss every concern about election integrity. If the voter registration system is vulnerable, prove it through lawful oversight, not by seeking other people’s ballots.
